S017-01.notes: Firm rejection delivered with courtesy and tact = diplomatic. Obsequious contradicts 'firmly rejected'; brusque contradicts courtesy; equivocal contradicts firmness.

flags: minor: 'reticent' is the trap word because it describes the new mayor, not the predecessor; good distractor
S017-02.notes: Predecessor never tired of speaking to reporters = loquacious. Vocabulary is the main hurdle (loquacious/reticent).

flags: minor: B says 'Evening visits' without 'weekday'; harmless since only weekday evenings are listed
S017-03.notes: Claim: evening hours, not general interest, explain most of the increase. B shows 85 of the 93-visit increase came in evenings while other periods were flat. A shows total increase only (consistent with general rise); C and D are partial/irrelevant. Data check: 380 -> 473, +93, correct.

S017-04.notes: Only that wasp pollinates the tree; fewer wasps -> less pollination -> fewer seeds. A contradicts 'only a single species'; B and C are illogical.

S017-05.notes: Population fell, yet businesses doubled: contrast/concession -> 'Even so,'.

flags: minor: choice A begins with 'Its' without naming the device, unlike the other choices; unusual for a standalone notes-synthesis answer and a mild tell/oddity
minor: A is the only choice describing a mechanism (crank -> gears -> pointers), making it very easy
S017-06.notes: Goal is how it operated; only A describes the operating sequence.

S017-07.notes: 'Since 2015' requires present perfect: has acquired. Simple past 'acquired' is the main trap.

S017-08.notes: Singular subject 'Each' -> depicts; intervening 'twelve paintings' is the trap.

S017-09.notes: Main idea: solar siblings with matching composition may share the Sun's birth cloud and could reveal its birth environment. A contradicts; B unsupported; C overstates ('fully reconstructed').

S017-10.notes: Face-only photographs remove voice, clothing, and smell cues, so preference for the handler's face isolates facial recognition. B supports clothing cue; C concerns voice; D is general familiarity with humans.
